info.name: CPS Access Control API
info.description: API Collection for CPS Access Control System — RBAC with JWT. Base URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/v1

request.description: Public endpoint — authenticates user with username and password.
Public endpoint — selects active department for user session.
Bearer auth — switches active department for current user.
Public endpoint — exchanges a valid refreshToken for a new accessToken.
Bearer auth — returns the currently authenticated user profile.
Bearer auth — returns the authorized menu tree for the current user.
Bearer auth — returns the flat list of all permitted actions for the current user.
SUPER_ADMIN — paginated user list with optional search keyword.
SUPER_ADMIN — returns full user details including department assignments.
SUPER_ADMIN — creates a new user account.

request.description: SUPER_ADMIN — activates or locks a user account.
SUPER_ADMIN — forces a new password for the user.
SUPER_ADMIN — returns a summary of the user's departments, roles, and permissions.
SUPER_ADMIN — lists all department-role assignments for a user.
SUPER_ADMIN — assigns a user to a department with a specific role.
SUPER_ADMIN — changes the department or role on an existing assignment.
SUPER_ADMIN — removes a department-role assignment from a user.
SUPER_ADMIN — permanently deletes a user account.
SUPER_ADMIN — paginated role list with optional status filter.
